WH_CORE.benchmark: Maple Grove: 300d MaxAge, 43 SOs, 62% manual upload, 30% online sell, 56 buyers, 76% repeat, $3,609 fees H1 (+33% YoY)

WH_ESUITE.desc: Digital layer + another ERP. Can upload inventory (XLS), K2K buying, branded eShop. No SOs or Future Sales.
WH_ESUITE.examples: Main Phila, Penn Valley, Tennessee FS
can_do: Upload boxes and bunches (XLS or manual)

WH_K2K.desc: Shows vendor inventory on eShop. Cannot upload own inventory. 100% dependent on vendor quality.
can_do: Show K2K vendor inventory on eShop (drop-ship)
cannot_do: Future Sales, Standing Orders, Open Market

WH_PROC.desc: Buy-only channel. No eShop, no selling online. Every purchase = indirect fees for Koronet (vendor side).

IMP_CORE.desc: Publishes inventory for wholesalers via K2K. DIFFERENT plays — they SELL into the network, not buy from it. Largest segment (84 accounts, 58% of Core).
IMP_CORE.examples: San Miguel, Allure Farms, Sofi's Flowers, Rosaprima
can_do: Publish inventory for wholesalers via K2K
IMP_CORE.key_metric: How many wholesaler buyers connected and actively buying via K2K?

IMP_K2K.desc: Publishes inventory, receives orders from wholesalers.

RET_WHOLESALE_BEHAVIOR.desc: Buys from importers/farms and resells. Treated as wholesaler for plays.

RET_PURE.desc: Buys from wholesalers for own shop. Limited plays.

GRW.desc: Produces flowers. Some have K2K/distribution activity. Verify behavior before excluding.

tx_scorecard_contract.purpose: Koronet independent Transactions scorecard. It joins expected transaction motion, applicable configuration evidence, activity and outcome without replacing implementation health.
rules: Only evaluate stages applicable to the account type and actual modules.
Missing evidence is FALTA_CONTEXTO, never a failure or a green pass.
Activity is read from approved control-plane work/commitment projections; this file never creates tasks.
No aggregate health score may hide which prerequisite, activity or evidence is missing.
tx_scorecard_contract.implementation_health_boundary: George and Christine calibrate config applicability and account exceptions. TX scorecard retains independent transaction expectation, activity, priority and reporting.

gate_eshop.question: ¿Existe el eShop?
gate_eshop.desc: Master switch. Enables eShop and all eCommerce. Without this = $0 online.
gate_eshop.if_wrong: eShop inaccessible. No inventory visible. Zero online sales possible.
gate_eshop.fix: ON at setup. If OFF, Implementation must enable.

can_show_inventory.question: ¿Puede mostrar inventory?
can_show_inventory.desc: Days products visible on eShop. 4-level precedence: product > category > customer > company. Default 10 = only spot buying. Top sellers use 30-365.
can_show_inventory.if_wrong: Too low (e.g. 4d): inventory 5+ days old disappears. Too high: stale inventory. Zero/blank: no inventory visible.
can_show_inventory.fix: 5-min fix: increase MaxAge in admin. 30+ for on-hand, 100+ for Open Market.

can_show_future.question: ¿Puede mostrar a futuro?
can_show_future.desc: Shows inventory not yet in warehouse. Without this, eShop = only TODAY's warehouse. Truck Days After controls visibility (DIFFERENT from MaxAge).
can_show_future.if_wrong: Future availability invisible. Buyers can't browse upcoming inventory catalog. Forward catalog empty.
can_show_future.fix: Enable ecommerceAllowFutureSales + Show Future Inventory. Create 'Future Sales' customer. Set Truck Days After to match buying horizon (14-21+d).

can_sell_bunches.question: ¿Puede vender bunches?
can_sell_bunches.desc: 95-98% of retail buys bunches. Without bunches = 2-5% TAM. Two settings: (1) Sell by Units = foundation toggle (company), (2) eShop bunches tab = paid add-on (location).
can_sell_bunches.if_wrong: Bunches tab doesn't appear in eShop. Buyers cannot see/order bunches. NOTE: flag controls eShop UI only — API/K2K bypass it.
can_sell_bunches.fix: 5-min fix for Sell by Units toggle. Bunches add-on = paid, request via Komet Support.

checkout_works.question: ¿Funciona el checkout?
checkout_works.desc: When ON, blocks checkout without payment method. Price's case: all config correct, $0 revenue because buyers had no payment method on file.
checkout_works.if_wrong: Silent $0 revenue. No error visible. Buyers browse but CANNOT buy.
checkout_works.fix: 5-min fix: verify correct value (ON for Wholesaler, OFF for Grower). Then verify buyers have payment methods on file.

sold_as_future.question: ¿Lo que compran aparece en el eShop?
sold_as_future.desc: Controls whether procurement inventory creates Open Market listings. Price's: 93% of prebooks have sold_as_future=No → cooler inventory invisible online.
sold_as_future.if_wrong: Procurement inventory never appears in eShop catalog. Bought product invisible to online buyers.
sold_as_future.fix: 5-min fix: toggle to YES on prebook items.

vendor_availability.setting: Vendor Availability + Show Vendor Availability on eCommerce
vendor_availability.question: ¿Se ven los productos K2K en el eShop?
vendor_availability.desc: Two linked settings: (1) company-level enables K2K ingestion, (2) location-level exposes in eShop. 72% of KBC's fees come from K2K — this is foundational.
vendor_availability.if_wrong: K2K vendor inventory bought but invisible in eShop. K2K revenue still flows via API/back-office but eShop channel is dark.

stages.name: CONEXIONES
stages.question: ¿Tiene conexiones K2K?
stages.if_no: Map needs, match vendors, create connections.
stages.lead: Day 3 sin primera compra post go-live
stages.lead_if_yes: Conexión activa → 30D sin compra | Compra offline de vendor conectado

stages.name: SUPPLY
stages.question: ¿Supply suficiente vs lo que vende?
stages.if_no: Connect vendors for missing categories, activate vendor availability, resolve format gaps (boxes vs bunches).

stages.name: ACTIVACIÓN
stages.question: ¿Compra regularmente?
stages.if_no: Guided first purchases, training on procurement workflow.

stages.name: HÁBITO
stages.question: ¿Compra consistentemente semana a semana?
stages.lead: Semana sin compra después de 3+ consecutivas

stages.name: RETENCIÓN
stages.question: ¿Mantiene o crece el volumen?
stages.if_no: Vendor loss analysis, price competitiveness, supply quality.

leakage_vs_gap.leakage: Compra OFFLINE de vendor con K2K activo → behavioral problem. The infrastructure exists, they're not using it.
leakage_vs_gap.gap: Compra OFFLINE de vendor SIN K2K → infrastructure problem. Vendor isn't in the network.

objection_procurement_expensive.description: RECURRING objection, NOT CLOSED. Bill Doran and WGF raised it.
objection_procurement_expensive.what_to_do: Do NOT dismiss. Run side-by-side pricing audit — NOT 2 samples, systematic. Compare Procurement prices vs offline for same product, same vendor, same period. If more expensive: escalate with data. If comparable/cheaper: show client with real numbers.
root_causes: Volume discounts not available in Procurement (offline reps negotiate)

buy_funnel.cs_procurement_tracking: CS must actively track procurement improvement in every active account. Not optional. Not only implementation. Metrics: adoption % at go-live vs current, if NOT improving after 30/60/90 days → investigate WHY, vendor activation rate, monthly procurement $ vs total buy-side $.

Tiene K2K pero compra offline A ESE MISMO vendor
Compra offline a vendor NO en K2K
buy_leads.action: ¿Vendor existe en red? Si sí → conectar. Si no → gap de red.

list_rubiks_cube.varieties: How many categories visible online? Benchmark: Maple Grove 112.
list_rubiks_cube.time: How far ahead? On-hand = MaxAge controls. Future = Truck Days After controls. DIFFERENT settings.
list_rubiks_cube.format: Bunches? Core = open boxes or upload. eSuite = upload only. K2K = depends on vendor. 95-98% retail = bunches. Without bunches = 2-5% TAM.
list_rubiks_cube.insight: Most wholesalers have one face partially solved. 100 categories but same-day/boxes-only = 1 of 3 faces.

sell_7stage_flow.question: Does the eShop exist AND is it findable?

sell_7stage_flow.name: Supply

sell_7stage_flow.name: Listing

sell_sustainability_score.concentration: Top 2 buyers < 50% of online GMV = healthy

sell_payment_gate: Before escalating 'mandatory payment blocks conversions' → need FUNNEL DATA first. How much traffic? How many registered? How deep does the funnel go? If traffic is near-zero, payment gate isn't the real blocker — discovery is.

tx_measurement_contract.entry_route_distribution: Hostname or branded-domain route is an adoption/attribution diagnostic only. It must never rank eShop performance or account priority.
tx_measurement_contract.conversion_readiness_rule: Conversion is interpretable only with inventory readiness and data coverage for the same account, channel and period. If either is absent or stale, display NOT_ASSESSABLE — never infer a conversion bottleneck.
conversion_diagnostic_chain: conversion: eligible sessions to completed online transaction
inventory_readiness: gate, breadth, depth, format and competitive price/terms

diagnostic_outcomes.demand_low_readiness_good: Discovery/demand hypothesis; not a conversion verdict.
diagnostic_outcomes.demand_good_readiness_low: Supply/listing/readiness hypothesis; not a conversion verdict.
diagnostic_outcomes.demand_and_readiness_good_conversion_low: Checkout, price, terms or UX hypothesis; requires evidence before action.

monetization.direct_indirect_rule: Direct and indirect GMV and fees must be calculated separately from validated transaction-side mapping. Unknown or ambiguous mappings remain UNATTRIBUTED; they must not be guessed.
monetization.monetizable_gmv: GMV eligible to generate a Koronet fee under the validated account/channel/side rule. It is not synonymous with online GMV.
monetization.effective_take_rate: SUM(fee_amount) / SUM(relevant_gross_gmv), shown only when denominator coverage is valid.
monetization.billed_coverage: SUM(billed_fee_amount) / SUM(expected_fee_amount on monetizable_gmv), shown only when rate and attribution coverage are valid.
monetization.unmonetized_monetizable_gap: monetizable_gmv less the validated fee-bearing GMV; never estimated from an unverified fee rate.

WH_CORE: "Procurement is expensive" — recurring objection, NOT closed. Side-by-side audit needed per account.
No digital standing orders — SOs are 100% offline (Core). $1.2M TAM blocked.
No volume discounts in Procurement — offline reps negotiate, online can't.
No bundling ("carne y hueso") — offline reps bundle product, eShop can't.
Future Sales bunches UI bug — "Add" button broken in Cards view (default). Only works in List view.
Multi-location carrier — 1 carrier per days-of-service. Blocks multi-location accounts.
WH_ESUITE: No SOs = no automated recurring inventory. Manual upload is the only path.
Most inventory lives in their other ERP, invisible to Koronet.
API integration is ideal but requires dev investment.
No Future Sales = can't show "what's coming in 2 weeks."
WH_K2K: 100% dependent on vendor quality. Poor vendor inventory = poor eShop.
Cannot differentiate from other K2K wholesalers showing same vendor inventory.
No own inventory = no competitive advantage on supply.
Buyers may go directly to vendor eShop instead.

abbreviations.K2K: Koronet-to-Koronet connection (vendor↔buyer). Both sides pay fees.
abbreviations.SO: Standing Order (recurring auto-PO, Core only, 100% offline)
abbreviations.MaxAge: Days inventory visible on eShop. Default 10, benchmark 300. 4-level precedence: product > category > customer > company.
abbreviations.Truck Days After: Days Future Sales inventory stays visible. DIFFERENT from MaxAge. Controls future inventory only.
abbreviations.API: External integration channel (e.g., Mayesh.com). API sales = $0 take-rate for Koronet — not good.
abbreviations.eShop: Customer's online storefront powered by Koronet
abbreviations.Open Market: Manual inventory upload (XLS or manual). Requires ecommerceAllowFutureSales.
abbreviations.Future Sales: Inventory not in warehouse yet, published via PO to 'Future Sales' customer. Core only.
abbreviations.Bunches: Individual flower bunches (vs boxes). 95-98% retail buys bunches. Without = 2-5% TAM.
abbreviations.Prebook: Forward purchase order. Buyer commits to future delivery date. Works without ecommerceAllowFutureSales. 90%+ of online accounts use this.
abbreviations.LEAKAGE: Buys OFFLINE from vendor with active K2K — behavioral problem, addressable now.
abbreviations.GAP: Buys OFFLINE from vendor WITHOUT K2K — infrastructure problem, needs vendor onboarding.
abbreviations.Web Hold: Per-line checkbox in Pricing screen. When ON, inventory invisible in eShop. Most common 'empty eShop' cause.
abbreviations.GPM: Gross Profit Margin (default 30% for wholesalers, 0% for growers)

list_challenger: Lo que no está en tu eShop no existe para tus clientes online.
No podés vender lo que no mostrás. (100 cats en cooler, 5 en eShop = tienda vacía)
Si solo comprás para mañana, tu eShop solo tiene lo de hoy.
Si solo vendés boxes online, el 95% de tu mercado no te puede comprar. (bunches = retail)
Lo que comprás por Koronet PUEDE aparecer automáticamente — pero no está configurado. (sold_as_future, 5 min fix)
No sabés cuántas ventas estás perdiendo. (los que entran, no encuentran, y se van → nunca los ves)
Si lo que mostrás online es PEOR que lo que tenés en el cooler → tus clientes van al cooler o compran en Mayesh.
Si querés ahorrar tiempo y tomar órdenes automáticas, subir inventario te lo ahorra. Tus vendedores pueden ser PROACTIVOS.
Si consistentemente ofrecés boxes Y bunches, con fulfillment local y mejor servicio → así te diferenciás de Mayesh.
buy_discovery: ¿Qué tipos de flores? ¿Solo boxes o también bunches?
¿Qué te importa cuando elegís un proveedor? ¿Precio? ¿Servicio? ¿Variedad?
¿Planificás compras a futuro o comprás para mañana?
¿Qué te piden tus clientes que no tenés disponible?
buy_challenger: Estás gastando $[X]/mes comprando offline de vendors que ESTÁN en la red. Eso es leakage — el producto existe online pero llamás por teléfono.
Sin compra anticipada, pagás precios spot. Vendors con 14-30d de visibilidad dan mejor precio porque pueden planificar.
Tus top 3 vendors por volumen son [X, Y, Z]. Si alguno tiene K2K, podés comparar precios en 2 minutos en vez de 3 llamadas.
Valentine's = 90 días de anticipación. Mother's = 60 días. Sin compra anticipada = spot a 2-3x.
Tenés [X] proveedores de rosas. Si uno tiene problema de cultivo, no tenés backup. 3+ vendors = reducción de riesgo.
